study: Tolan et al. 2020 (GBG + MyTeachingPartner for new teachers; J. School Psychology 78)
delivery_evidence: Genuine mix of in-person and online: an intensive in-person training workshop plus ~8 biweekly MyTeachingPartner coaching cycles that began with 'initial contact in-person that then shifted to web-mediated training' (video upload, online prompts, online cycle-tracking system) -- MTP is explicitly 'a web-mediated, video-based coaching approach' (sec. 2.3.2 'Training in the GBG+MTP program', p.82-84).
test_alignment_evidence: Full-sample achievement outcomes are the Woodcock-Johnson III reading and math composites, broad independent norm-referenced standardized tests not tailored to the intervention (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table 5, p.87).
curriculum_evidence: Intervention is a combined classroom-management / teacher-interaction practice program (PAX Good Behavior Game behavior framework + MTP coaching on teacher-student interactions); it improves teachers' practice and does not provide a new academic curriculum/textbook/materials package (sec. 2.3.2, p.82-84).
outcome_timing_evidence: WJ-III achievement measured at a spring posttest following the single academic year of training/coaching (fall baseline to spring posttest); no delayed follow-up wave (extraction timepoint 'post, spring of training year'; p.84, Table 2).
